viltrumitecore.city.help.title: Living city commands:
viltrumitecore.city.help.disable: - turn the city off and remove all citizens
viltrumitecore.city.help.populate: <count> - add citizens around you right now
viltrumitecore.city.help.clear: - remove all citizens (the city stays on)
viltrumitecore.city.help.status: - city, citizens, districts and restore state
viltrumitecore.city.help.reset: - restore every destroyed block of the map
